source.author: verg
source.text: Stant arae circum, et crines effusa sacerdos ter centum tonat ore deos, Erebumque Chaosque, tergeminamque Hecaten, tria virginis ora Dianae.
source.text_original: Stant arae circum, et crines effusa sacerdos / ter centum tonat ore deos, Erebumque Chaosque, / tergeminamque Hecaten, tria virginis ora Dianae.
source.text_english: Altars stand around, and the priestess, her hair loosened, thunders with her mouth the three hundred gods, Erebus and Chaos, and triple Hecate, and the three faces of the maiden Diana.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_original: tergeminam cum placat eram Stygiasque supremo / obsecrat igne domos, iam iam exorabile retro / carmen agens; neque enim ante leves niger avehit umbras / portitor, et vinctae primis stant faucibus Orci.
reuse.text_english: When he soothes the triple goddess and, with his final fire, implores the Stygian dwellings, now at last uttering a spell that can move to pity and lead back what was gone; for the dark ferryman does not yet carry off the light shades, and the chained ones stand fast at the first jaws of Orco.
